meta.name: version-bump
meta.description: Automated semantic versioning and release workflow for Claude Code plugins. Handles version increments across package.json, marketplace.json, plugin.json manifests, build verification, git tagging, GitHub releases, and changelog generation. NPM publishing (so `npx claude-mem@X.Y.Z` resolves) is handed off to the human maintainer, who raised npm security.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动管理版本号并生成发布流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次发布前都要手动改版本号和写更新日志
copy.tagline_en: Automate version bumps and release workflows
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manually update version numbers and changelogs before every release

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会自动执行语义化版本递增和发布流程:更新所有清单文件中的版本号、构建并同步、提交并打标签、推送、创建 GitHub Release、重新生成变更日志、发送 Discord 通知;其中 npm 发布会交给人工处理。
howto.when: 当用户要求对 Claude Code 插件执行版本升级或发布,例如说"bump version"或"发布新版本"时触发。

say.text: 把版本号从 1.2.3 升到 1.2.4,走完整发布流程
say.note: Claude 会更新所有版本文件并执行发布步骤

say.text: 这次是修 bug,打一个补丁版本并发布
say.note: Claude 会按 PATCH 规则递增版本

say.text: 帮我创建 GitHub Release,版本号 v2.0.0
say.note: 需要先完成前面的提交和打标签

howto.what_en: Claude runs the release workflow: updates versions in all manifests, builds, syncs, commits, tags, pushes, creates GitHub release, regenerates changelog, sends Discord notification. npm publish is left to the human.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to bump a version or release an update for the Claude Code plugin, e.g., 'bump version' or 'publish a new release'.

say_en.text: Bump the version from 1.2.3 to 1.2.4 and run the full release flow.
say_en.note: Claude updates all version files and proceeds with release steps.

say_en.text: This is a bug fix; bump a patch version and publish.
say_en.note: Claude increments the version according to PATCH rules.

say_en.text: Create a GitHub release with version v2.0.0.
say_en.note: Requires the version to be committed and tagged first.
